events.description: The first host command was terminated by a 60-second orchestration timeout before stdout, stderr, or decision artifacts were produced.

The successful evidence aggregation produced zero compact audit-computation failures, and pandas serialized zero-column, zero-row frames as a single newline. Reporting then raised EmptyDataError while counting the combined file. Both zero-row result artifacts were normalized to the registered failure schema by adding only the CSV header; no data row was added, removed, or changed.
